name: orchestrator-routing
description: Evals for orchestrator delegation decisions — does it route to the right agent? Covers trivial edits, multi-file implementation, architecture decisions, external research, codebase search, and progressive disclosure tasks. Balanced: some tasks should delegate, some should be handled directly.

evals.prompt: Add a one-line comment to the top of src/cli/eval.ts explaining what this file does
evals.description: Trivial single-file edit should be handled directly, not delegated

assertions.description: Should handle a trivial comment addition directly, without delegating

evals.prompt: Refactor the error handling in src/hooks/ to use a consistent pattern across all hooks. Right now each hook handles errors differently.

assertions.description: Should not delegate to oracle for implementation

evals.prompt: Should we switch the background job board from in-memory storage to SQLite? What are the tradeoffs for this plugin?
Look up how the Anthropic SDK handles streaming responses and what the latest API changes are
evals.description: External library research should route to @librarian

evals.prompt: Find all the places where we call emitEvent in the codebase
What does the package.json scripts section do? List the available npm scripts.
evals.description: Trivia about the codebase should be handled directly, not delegated

assertions.description: Should answer trivial knowledge directly, without delegating

evals.prompt: I keep running the same manual checks before every release. Look at my recent sessions and tell me what I should turn into reusable commands or skills.
evals.description: Should trigger @reflect skill and read its reference file for detailed patterns

assertions.description: Should read the reflect skill reference file

evals.prompt: I'm debugging why the SDK handles tool calls differently than expected. Clone the opencode SDK source so I can inspect how it actually works internally.
evals.description: Should trigger @clonedeps skill and read its reference file

assertions.description: Should read the clonedeps skill reference file

evals.prompt: I'm about to refactor the prompt cache to a different invalidation strategy. Plan how I should verify the change actually works before I ship it.
evals.description: Should trigger @verification-planning skill and read its reference file

assertions.description: Should read the verification-planning skill reference file

evals.prompt: We're migrating the plugin from CommonJS to ESM — it touches every module and can't be shipped half-done. Manage this as a phased effort with reviews between phases.
evals.description: Should trigger @deepwork skill and read its reference file

assertions.description: Should read the deepwork skill reference file

evals.prompt: Design a dark mode toggle for the settings page with responsive layout and smooth transitions.
evals.description: User-facing UI work should route to @designer

evals.prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer with just the city name.
evals.description: Orchestrator should provide helpful, substantive responses, not placeholder text

assertions.description: Should not contain the exact placeholder phrase
Should not contain prompting for next steps

evals.prompt: Explain what the orchestrator agent does in this system in one or two sentences.
evals.description: Orchestrator should give substantive explanations, not placeholder text

assertions.description: Should not contain the exact placeholder phrase
Should not contain the partial phrase
Should not contain the prompting phrase
